importedPlanMetadata: Plan import metadata, validation summary, and fairness flags when the attempt used an imported plan.

surfaceUpdate.segmentsAvailable: number of imported surface update segments
surfaceUpdate.automatedExecution: false until surface-update automation is implemented

replaySeedContract.replaySeedAnchor: UUID seed anchor used for deterministic challenge regeneration
replaySeedContract.generationConfig: config snapshot used with the UUID seed anchor
replaySeedContract.derivedSeeds: namespace-specific seeds derived from the UUID

exactReplay: available from snapshot when a challenge snapshot is embedded/available; otherwise available only when UUID/config/version/seeds are complete and compatible

comparison.rows: Plan comparison rows for manual, greedyBaseline, importedSolver, or unknown sources when available.
comparison.winner: winning row selected by finalScore when available
comparison.notes: simple explanatory notes about likely winning factors
comparison.metrics: expectedValue, realizedValue, finalScore, energyUsed, staticHazardsHit, mobileHazardsHit, depthExposure, riskExposure, forecastRegret, completedWaypoints, missedWaypoints

stochasticRun.rngSeed: seed used for deterministic per-cell ROI manifestation

stochastic.seed: deterministic seed for realized ROI outcomes
stochastic.rerunGroupId: session-local id for same-plan stochastic reruns
stochastic.planFingerprint: simple fingerprint of waypoint plan fields
stochastic.runIndex: 1-based run order within the rerun group
stochastic.expectedValue: sum of expected sampled ROI value
stochastic.realizedValue: sum of realized sampled ROI value

stochasticRunHistory: compact array of seed-specific run summaries for current session reruns

risk.shallowExposure: steps or frames with shallow-energy multiplier
risk.deepExposure: steps or frames with deep-water benefit
risk.depthEnergyPenalty: numeric extra energy from shallow depth

drift.samples: number of physics samples used for drift summary
drift.averageCurrentAssist: mean current component aligned with the active waypoint heading
drift.averageCrossCurrent: mean absolute cross-current component during execution
drift.assistSamples: count of samples with helpful along-track current
drift.oppositionSamples: count of samples with opposing along-track current
drift.stochasticDriftSeed: seed used for deterministic stochastic drift noise
drift.stochasticDriftSamples: count of samples where nonzero drift noise was applied
drift.averageStochasticNoiseMagnitude: mean magnitude of seeded current perturbation when enabled

endCondition.mode: none | surface | communication | recovery | pickup | return
endCondition.achieved: whether the final condition was achieved
endCondition.success: false only when required and not achieved

priorityTargets.available: number of temporal priority targets that are active at least once
priorityTargets.missed: available minus captured; no penalty unless mission scoring config enables one
priorityTargets.score: score added from captured target values
priorityTargets.capturedIds: target ids captured at least once
priorityTargets.captures: targetId, agentId, t, x, y, value records
priorityTargets.duplicates: duplicate capture attempts after a target was already captured

notes: Readable schema-like documentation; validation is lightweight/manual. Frames include per-agent position, heading, battery, energy, active waypoint, waypoint index, status, commsState, and depthEnergyMultiplier. Events may include sampled cells with expected/realized value, explicit probabilityOutcome records, mobileHazard contacts/near misses, depthEnergy, surfaced, submerged, and replanned decisions.
